hardware_constraint: All screws, washers and spacers must be insulating; no metal inserts or metal through-bolts across the boards.
spacer_option: M2 8mm insulating spacer plus .5mm insulating washer as nominal dimensional option; exact part, tolerance and assembly remain to be qualified.
status: Native 2.4mm internal cutouts for M2 insulating fasteners; full pad/track/via/pour exclusions retained. Manufacturing must process all three internal circles in Edge.Cuts. Mechanical assembly and material qualification remain pending.
